column1: # clear: Monsieur j'ai l'honneur de vous mander ... et j'espere etre en etat
# clear: Le 7 je seroit a bonheur

# note 6x pass 26 Oct 2026 (y~480-535): no sign between "je" and "croi" (the NEW1 token was a double count, dropped); after croi: G24 dash (b) i e n, then G14 q, G08 u, G07 e = "bien que"; the 8 tokens after 750 (733 Son Altesse < ? < 801 Republique]) were a code-table bracket split on spaces, not signs: 750 stands alone, underlined, followed by a u r a t
# clear: Je me recommande a l'honneur de vos bonne grace ... Magdebourg ce 3 Aou 1783. No. 2. (signature in numeric/symbol cipher, not read)

# reading: (j'espere etre en etat) de me presenter personnellement au roi pour la correspondance tout est arrange. (Le 7 je seroit de bonne heure) a Potsdam et je croi bien que 750 (Prince de Prusse) aurat prit les arangemans necessaire d'etre averti du moment de mon arrivee et de me faire avoir ses ordres.

# note 6x pass 26 Oct 2026, line 4 (y~530-600): 'trouver' was a misreading: d e t r e, then an arch with a long right leg (G09 a; earlier read as part of an o), G10 v e r, large L (G03 t), G17 i = d'etre averti; then the inverted T as d (G15) + G08 u = du moment. The tall stroke under the 'e a' is the J of the clear 'Je me recommande' below, not a sign

# notes: line 1 G13 G05 G07 G18 G09 G03 = presanter (writer's spelling); inverted-T sign serves as o (G01) and d (G15) by context; line 4 re-read 26 Oct (d'etre averti du moment), no unread signs left
